Inspect or repair a cached attachment's verification receipt.

Source: R/download_public.R
reconcile_cached_download.Rd

A non-empty legacy file is deliberately left unverified unless both its expected size and SHA-256 are supplied by a trusted publication outcome. When those values match the bytes already on disk, repair = TRUE publishes the receipt locally and avoids another HTTP request. A .part path is always reported as an interrupted staging file.

Usage

reconcile_cached_download(
  path,
  expected_size_bytes = NA_real_,
  expected_sha256 = NA_character_,
  url = NA_character_,
  content_type = NA_character_,
  repair = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Canonical attachment path (or a staging .part path).

expected_size_bytes

Trusted byte count from the publication outcome.

expected_sha256

Trusted SHA-256 from the publication outcome.

url

Original source URL to store in a repaired receipt.

content_type

Optional response content type to store in a repaired receipt.

repair

If TRUE, publish a receipt only after both trusted values match the existing bytes.

Value

A one-row tibble with path, status, size_bytes, sha256, receipt_path, and reason. Status is one of missing, partial, unverified, verified, or repaired.
